title: Fishing Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often fishing metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on fishing metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out how often your fishing metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
